title.zh: Radicle: Disclosure of Vulnerability in the Network Protocol
title.en: Radicle: Disclosure of Vulnerability in the Network Protocol

current_state.zh: Radicle disclosed a vulnerability in its network protocol in which inter-node traffic is unencrypted and unauthenticated, urging users to halt use of private repositories over the network until a security update is released.
current_state.en: Radicle disclosed a vulnerability in its network protocol in which inter-node traffic is unencrypted and unauthenticated, urging users to halt use of private repositories over the network until a security update is released.
